verdict.rationale: cubic documents a CLI that reviews local changes before you push and can be set up in Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, Codex and other coding tools, so pre-push review from the editor is a first-party capability. The docs do not show this is the same review as the PR review, and the CLI docs recommend connecting ChatGPT (Codex) or Claude Code for more capable review models, which suggests local review quality depends on configuration. missing for 10: documented parity between local/IDE review and PR review (same rules, custom agents, findings), a native in-editor review surface rather than CLI or coding-agent mediation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I get the same review inside my IDE before I push, catching issues while the code is still in my editor

citations.quote: The cubic CLI reviews local changes before you push. It finds bugs and generates a prompt that your coding agent can use to fix them.
Install and connect cubic in Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, or another coding tool.
We recommend connecting ChatGPT (Codex) or Claude Code for access to more capable review models.
